vocabulary.definition: The space inside a triangle. A triangle is half of a rectangle with the same base and height, so A = ½ × b × h.
vocabulary.definitionEs: El espacio dentro de un triángulo. Un triángulo es la mitad de un rectángulo con la misma base y altura, por eso A = ½ × b × h.
vocabulary.visual: A = ½ × b × h; if b = 8 and h = 5, then A = ½ × 8 × 5 = 20 square units

vocabulary.definition: Any side of a triangle can be the base. Once you pick a base, the height must be measured perpendicular (at a 90° angle) to it.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Cualquier lado de un triángulo puede ser la base. Una vez que eliges la base, la altura debe medirse perpendicular (en un ángulo de 90°) a ella.

copyPanel.formula: Area = ½ × Base × Height (A = ½ b · h)
steps: 1. Identify the base and the perpendicular height to that base
2. A triangle is exactly half of a rectangle with the same base and height
3. Multiply base by height, then divide by 2

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Painting a Cabin
revealWordProblem.text: The front of this A-frame cabin is a triangle with a base of 34 ft and a height of 23¾ ft. Find the area of the triangular front that needs to be painted.
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A photograph of an A-frame cabin with its triangular front outlined, labeled 34 feet across the base and 23 and three-fourths feet for the height.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 34 × 23¾. First, 23¾ = 23.75, so 34 × 23.75 = 807.5. Then take half: 807.5 ÷ 2 = 403.75. The triangular front of the cabin has an area of 403.75 square feet.

questions.stem: What is the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 6 cm?
questions.explanation: A = ½ × b × h = ½ × 10 × 6 = 30 square centimeters.
choiceFeedback: 16 comes from adding 10 + 6. Area means multiply the base and height, then take half.
The number is right, but cm measures length. Area needs square units (sq cm).
60 is base × height — the full rectangle. A triangle is half of that, so multiply by ½.
hints: You have a base of 10 cm and a height of 6 cm — a triangle needs only those two, plus one special step.
A triangle is half of a rectangle: use A = ½ × b × h. If you only multiply, your answer is twice too big.
Multiply 10 × 6, then take half of the product. Area units are square centimeters.
questions.stemEs: ¿Cuál es el área de un triángulo con base de 10 cm y altura de 6 cm?
questions.explanationEs: A = ½ × b × h = ½ × 10 × 6 = 30 centímetros cuadrados.
hintsEs: Tienes una base de 10 cm y una altura de 6 cm: un triángulo solo necesita esas dos, más un paso especial.
Un triángulo es la mitad de un rectángulo: usa A = ½ × b × h. Si solo multiplicas, tu respuesta sale al doble.
Multiplica 10 × 6 y luego saca la mitad del producto. Las unidades de área son centímetros cuadrados.

questions.stem: A triangle has an area of 24 sq ft and a base of 8 ft. What is the height?
choiceFeedback: 3 is 24 ÷ 8 — but that skips the ½. Double the area first: 2 × 24 = 48, then divide by the base.
12 is half of 24 — that divides by 2 instead of doubling. Try 2 × 24 = 48, then ÷ 8.
16 comes from 24 − 8. Use h = (2 × area) ÷ base instead of subtracting.
hints: The area (24 sq ft) and base (8 ft) are given — you're solving backwards for the height.
Simplify first: ½ × 8 = 4, so the equation becomes 24 = 4 × h.
Divide 24 by 4 to find the height in feet.
questions.stemEs: Un triángulo tiene un área de 24 sq ft y una base de 8 ft. ¿Cuál es la altura?
hintsEs: Te dan el área (24 pies²) y la base (8 pies): estás despejando la altura al revés.
Simplifica primero: ½ × 8 = 4, así que la ecuación se vuelve 24 = 4 × h.
Divide 24 entre 4 para hallar la altura en pies.

questions.stem: Why do we divide by 2 when finding the area of a triangle?
choices: A triangle is exactly half of a rectangle with the same base and height
The base is always twice the height
We always divide area formulas by 2
questions.explanation: A triangle with base b and height h fits inside a rectangle with the same base and height. The triangle covers exactly half the rectangle, so A = ½ × b × h.
choiceFeedback: The height is perpendicular to them.
hints: Think about drawing a diagonal across a rectangle — what two shapes does it create?
Compare a triangle to a rectangle with the same base and height. How much of the rectangle does the triangle cover?
Sketch a rectangle, draw one diagonal, and shade one triangle. What fraction of the rectangle did you shade?
questions.stemEs: ¿Por qué dividimos entre 2 al hallar el área de un triángulo?
questions.explanationEs: Un triángulo con base b y altura h cabe dentro de un rectángulo con la misma base y la misma altura. El triángulo cubre exactamente la mitad del rectángulo, así que A = ½ × b × h.
choicesEs: Un triángulo es exactamente la mitad de un rectángulo con la misma base y la misma altura
La base siempre es el doble de la altura
Siempre dividimos entre 2 las fórmulas de área
hintsEs: Piensa en trazar una diagonal en un rectángulo: ¿qué dos figuras se forman?
Compara un triángulo con un rectángulo de la misma base y altura. ¿Qué parte del rectángulo cubre el triángulo?
Dibuja un rectángulo, traza una diagonal y sombrea un triángulo. ¿Qué fracción del rectángulo sombreaste?

reviewHighlights.formula: Area = ½ × Base × Height (A = ½ b · h)
steps: 1. Identify the base and the perpendicular height to that base
2. A triangle is exactly half of a rectangle with the same base and height
3. Multiply base by height, then divide by 2
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Area of Triangles is forgetting the ½ — students multiply base × height like a rectangle and stop there, or they use the triangle's slanted side instead of the perpendicular height that's already given. Always check: did I take half, and did I use the straight-up height, not the slanted side?

level1.stem: A triangle has a base of 4 m and a height of 3 m. Find its area.
level1.stemEs: Un triángulo tiene una base de 4 m y una altura de 3 m. Halla su área.
hints: Multiply the base by the height. Then take half.
hintsEs: Multiplica la base por la altura. Luego toma la mitad.
level1.explanation: Multiply the base by the height: 4 × 3 = 12 Take half: 1/2 × 12 = 6
level1.explanationEs: Multiplica la base por la altura: 4 × 3 = 12 Toma la mitad: 1/2 × 12 = 6

level1.stem: A triangle has a base of 10 in and a height of 5 in. Find its area.
level1.stemEs: Un triángulo tiene una base de 10 pulg y una altura de 5 pulg. Halla su área.
hints: Multiply 10 × 5. Then take half.
hintsEs: Multiplica 10 × 5. Luego toma la mitad.
level1.explanation: Multiply the base by the height: 10 × 5 = 50 Take half: 1/2 × 50 = 25
level1.explanationEs: Multiplica la base por la altura: 10 × 5 = 50 Toma la mitad: 1/2 × 50 = 25

level1.stem: A garden is shaped like a triangle. Its base is 14 m and its height is 3 m. What is its area?
level1.stemEs: Un jardín tiene forma de triángulo. Su base mide 14 m y su altura mide 3 m. ¿Cuál es su área?
hints: Multiply the base by the height. Then take half.
hintsEs: Multiplica la base por la altura. Luego toma la mitad.
level1.explanation: Multiply the base by the height: 14 × 3 = 42 Take half: 1/2 × 42 = 21
level1.explanationEs: Multiplica la base por la altura: 14 × 3 = 42 Toma la mitad: 1/2 × 42 = 21

level1.stem: A triangle has a base of 6 ft and a height of 5 ft. Find its area.
level1.stemEs: Un triángulo tiene una base de 6 pies y una altura de 5 pies. Halla su área.
hints: Multiply the base by the height. Then take half.
hintsEs: Multiplica la base por la altura. Luego toma la mitad.
level1.explanation: Multiply the base by the height: 6 × 5 = 30 Take half: 1/2 × 30 = 15
level1.explanationEs: Multiplica la base por la altura: 6 × 5 = 30 Toma la mitad: 1/2 × 30 = 15

level1.stem: A triangle has a base of 18 m and a height of 11 m. Find its area.
level1.stemEs: Un triángulo tiene una base de 18 m y una altura de 11 m. Halla su área.
hints: Find 18 × 11 first. Then take half of it.
hintsEs: Primero halla 18 × 11. Luego toma la mitad.
level1.explanation: Multiply the base by the height: 18 × 11 = 198 Take half: 1/2 × 198 = 99
level1.explanationEs: Multiplica la base por la altura: 18 × 11 = 198 Toma la mitad: 1/2 × 198 = 99

level2.stem: Sam says a triangle with a base of 10 in and a height of 7 in has an area of 70 square inches. Is he right? What is the area?
level2.stemEs: Sam dice que un triángulo con una base de 10 pulg y una altura de 7 pulg tiene un área de 70 pulgadas cuadradas. ¿Tiene razón? ¿Cuál es el área?
hints: Sam found the rectangle. What part of the rectangle is the triangle?
hintsEs: Sam halló el rectángulo. ¿Qué parte del rectángulo es el triángulo?
level2.explanation: Find the rectangle with the same base and height: 10 × 7 = 70 Take half for the triangle: 1/2 × 70 = 35
level2.explanationEs: Halla el rectángulo con la misma base y altura: 10 × 7 = 70 Toma la mitad para el triángulo: 1/2 × 70 = 35

level2.stem: A triangle has an area of 28 square meters. Its height is 8 m. How long is its base?
level2.stemEs: Un triángulo tiene un área de 28 metros cuadrados. Su altura mide 8 m. ¿Cuánto mide su base?
hints: Double the area first. Then divide by the height.
hintsEs: Primero duplica el área. Luego divide entre la altura.
level2.explanation: Double the area to undo the half: 28 × 2 = 56 Divide by the height: 56 ÷ 8 = 7
level2.explanationEs: Duplica el área para deshacer la mitad: 28 × 2 = 56 Divide entre la altura: 56 ÷ 8 = 7

level2.stem: A triangle has a base of 12 cm and a height of 5 cm. Find its area.
level2.stemEs: Un triángulo tiene una base de 12 cm y una altura de 5 cm. Halla su área.
hints: Multiply the base by the height. Then take half.
hintsEs: Multiplica la base por la altura. Luego toma la mitad.
level2.explanation: Multiply the base by the height: 12 × 5 = 60 Take half: 1/2 × 60 = 30
level2.explanationEs: Multiplica la base por la altura: 12 × 5 = 60 Toma la mitad: 1/2 × 60 = 30

level2.stem: Triangle A has a base of 12 ft and a height of 4 ft. Triangle B has a base of 6 ft and a height of 8 ft. Which triangle has more area?
level2.stemEs: El triángulo A tiene una base de 12 pies y una altura de 4 pies. El triángulo B tiene una base de 6 pies y una altura de 8 pies. ¿Cuál triángulo tiene más área?
hints: Find each area. Do not judge by one length.
hintsEs: Halla cada área. No juzgues por una sola longitud.
level2.explanation: Find the area of triangle A: 1/2 × 12 × 4 = 24 Find the area of triangle B: 1/2 × 6 × 8 = 24
level2.explanationEs: Halla el área del triángulo A: 1/2 × 12 × 4 = 24 Halla el área del triángulo B: 1/2 × 6 × 8 = 24
choiceFeedback: A has the longer base, but B is taller. Both areas are 24 square feet.
B is taller, but A has the longer base. Both areas are 24 square feet.

level2.stem: The front of a tent is a triangle. It is 8 feet wide at the bottom and 6 feet tall. What is the area of the tent front?
level2.stemEs: El frente de una tienda de campaña es un triángulo. Mide 8 pies de ancho abajo y 6 pies de alto. ¿Cuál es el área del frente de la tienda?
hints: The width at the bottom is the base. How tall it is is the height.
hintsEs: El ancho de abajo es la base. Lo alto es la altura.
level2.explanation: Find the base and the height: b = 8, h = 6 Multiply, then take half: 8 × 6 = 48; 1/2 × 48 = 24
level2.explanationEs: Halla la base y la altura: b = 8, h = 6 Multiplica y luego toma la mitad: 8 × 6 = 48; 1/2 × 48 = 24

level3.stem: A triangular garden bed has a base of 14 meters and a perpendicular height of 6 meters. What is its area?
choiceFeedback: That halves the sum of 14 and 6. Multiply first: half of 14 times 6.
That adds 14 and 6. Multiply the two measurements, then halve.
That is base times height with no halving, which gives the PARALLELOGRAM area. A triangle is half of it.
level3.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 14 × 6 = 42 square meters.

level3.stem: A triangle has an area of 30 square centimeters and a base of 12 cm. Kim says the height is 2.5 cm, because 30 ÷ 12 = 2.5. What is the correct height?
level3.stemEs: Un triángulo tiene un área de 30 centímetros cuadrados y una base de 12 cm. Kim dice que la altura es 2.5 cm, porque 30 ÷ 12 = 2.5. ¿Cuál es la altura correcta?
hints: Kim forgot something about triangles. What must you do to the area first?
hintsEs: Kim olvidó algo de los triángulos. ¿Qué debes hacer primero con el área?
level3.explanation: Double the area to undo the half: 30 × 2 = 60 Divide by the base: 60 ÷ 12 = 5 Check with the formula: 1/2 × 12 × 5 = 30
level3.explanationEs: Duplica el área para deshacer la mitad: 30 × 2 = 60 Divide entre la base: 60 ÷ 12 = 5 Comprueba con la fórmula: 1/2 × 12 × 5 = 30

level3.stem: A triangle has an area of 54 square feet. Its base is 12 feet. What is its height?
level3.stemEs: Un triángulo tiene un área de 54 pies cuadrados. Su base mide 12 pies. ¿Cuál es su altura?
hints: Double the area. Then divide by the base.
hintsEs: Duplica el área. Luego divide entre la base.
level3.explanation: Double the area to undo the half: 54 × 2 = 108 Divide by the base: 108 ÷ 12 = 9
level3.explanationEs: Duplica el área para deshacer la mitad: 54 × 2 = 108 Divide entre la base: 108 ÷ 12 = 9

level3.stem: The front of a cabin is a triangle 20 feet wide at the bottom and 15 feet tall. One can of paint covers 50 square feet. How many cans cover the front?
level3.stemEs: El frente de una cabaña es un triángulo de 20 pies de ancho abajo y 15 pies de alto. Una lata de pintura cubre 50 pies cuadrados. ¿Cuántas latas cubren el frente?
hints: Find the area of the triangle first. Then see how many 50s fit.
hintsEs: Primero halla el área del triángulo. Luego ve cuántos 50 caben.
level3.explanation: Find the area of the front: 1/2 × 20 × 15 = 150 Divide by what one can covers: 150 ÷ 50 = 3
level3.explanationEs: Halla el área del frente: 1/2 × 20 × 15 = 150 Divide entre lo que cubre una lata: 150 ÷ 50 = 3

level3.stem: A right triangle has short sides of 9 cm and 12 cm. Its long side is 15 cm. What is the height from the square corner to the 15 cm side?
level3.stemEs: Un triángulo rectángulo tiene lados cortos de 9 cm y 12 cm. Su lado largo mide 15 cm. ¿Cuál es la altura desde la esquina cuadrada hasta el lado de 15 cm?
hints: The two short sides meet at a square corner. Use them to find the area first.
hintsEs: Los dos lados cortos forman una esquina cuadrada. Úsalos primero para hallar el área.
level3.explanation: Find the area with the short sides: 1/2 × 9 × 12 = 54 Use 15 as the new base: 54 = 1/2 × 15 × h Double the area. Divide by 15: 54 × 2 = 108; 108 ÷ 15 = 7.2
level3.explanationEs: Halla el área con los lados cortos: 1/2 × 9 × 12 = 54 Usa 15 como la base nueva: 54 = 1/2 × 15 × h Duplica el área. Divide entre 15: 54 × 2 = 108; 108 ÷ 15 = 7.2
